title: Each prerequisite add decodes every retained edge's binding event, so one add costs as much as the item's in-degree
outcome: Each prerequisite add decodes every retained edge's binding event, so one add costs as much as the item's in-degree
acceptance: A test adds prerequisites one at a time to one item and asserts that the canonical decodes of each add stay within a constant that does not grow with the item's existing prerequisite count, with no stored-format change
Every edge that fails its proof today is still refused or reported, covered by the existing prerequisite-proof tests
